title: Website Auditor leaf finding
description: The intermediate findings format every upstream Wave-5/W6 Drone (technical-seo, aeo-audit, content-semantics, internal-linking, visual-funnel, accessibility-audit, web-security-posture, analytics-stack, performance-cwv, social-presence, blog-content, ecommerce-catalog) must write for each 0-6 leaf checkpoint it evaluates. audit-scoring-wasp-drone (wave W7) reads only files that validate against this schema; a leaf finding that is missing a required field is REJECTED back to the originating Drone per prd-020 AC-5, never scored anyway. Field names and mandatory-ness are sourced from build plan section 4.1 ('Every score carries three mandatory fields: the numeric value, the evidence pointer, and a one-line justification'); the surrounding envelope fields (category_key, subaudit_key, originating_bee, etc.) are this Stinger's own engineering design, needed to route a finding to the right cell in the Scorecard sheet and to route a rejection back to the right Drone.

leaf_id.description: Stable identifier for this leaf checkpoint, unique within its sub-audit. Convention: '<CATEGORY_KEY>-<SUBAUDIT_KEY>-<NN>' matching the Scorecard sheet's own leaf_id column, e.g. 'SECURITY-HEADERS-01'.

category_key.description: Which of the 8 categories this leaf rolls up into. Must match one of the 8 category keys in the Rubric sheet's named ranges (see guides/02-retuning-weights.md).

subaudit_key.description: Which named sub-audit within category_key this leaf belongs to. Must be one of the sub-audit keys defined for that category on the Rubric sheet (e.g. 'headers', 'tls', 'cookies' under category_key='security').

description.description: One-line human-readable description of what this checkpoint tests, e.g. 'Strict-Transport-Security header present with max-age >= 6 months'.

score.description: The 0-6 leaf score per build plan section 4.1: 0=N/A (excluded from rollup, not a failure), 1=F/Critical through 6=A/None. Boolean checkpoints resolve only to 1 or 6, never a value between.

is_boolean_checkpoint.description: True when this checkpoint is a strict present/absent test that must resolve only to 1 or 6 (build plan section 4.1). audit-scoring-wasp-drone rejects a boolean checkpoint scored 2-5.

evidence_pointer.description: Mandatory. File path, URL, HTTP header name/value, or screenshot path inside the shared audit workspace proving this score. Never a reconstruction from memory; captured at the moment of finding per the conduct rules (build plan section 7).

justification.description: Mandatory. One-line justification connecting the evidence to the score. audit-scoring-wasp-drone rejects a leaf missing this field rather than scoring it (prd-020 AC-5, Non-Goals).

page_url.description: The specific crawled page this finding applies to, when applicable (site-wide findings, e.g. a security header, may be null).

subjective.description: True when this finding is a [subjective] judgement per the conduct rules (build plan section 7), kept separate from quantified findings in both the rubric and the reports.

originating_bee.description: The Wave-5/W6 Drone that produced this finding, e.g. 'web-security-posture-wasp-drone'. Used to route a rejection back to the correct Drone.

severity.description: Optional severity label for the Findings Register (distinct from the 0-6 score; a score of 1 with severity 'critical' is what feeds the Security override, see guides/02-critical-security-override.md).

remediation.description: Optional one-line remediation suggestion for the Findings Register.

effort_hours_band.description: Optional effort-to-remediate band for the Findings Register (per prd-020's open question default: effort in hours, three-plus bands).

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the evidence was captured, per the 'evidence at the moment of finding' conduct rule.

examples.description: Strict-Transport-Security header present with max-age >= 6 months
examples.justification: curl -I response shows no Strict-Transport-Security header on the landing page or any of the 12 sampled internal pages.
examples.remediation: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' at the edge/CDN or app server.
